Snapshot-test an extracted table

Source: R/validate_table.R
expect_table_snapshot.Rd

Wraps testthat::expect_snapshot() to lock in the printed representation of a table stored in a session. On first run the snapshot is written to tests/testthat/_snaps/; subsequent runs compare against that baseline.

Usage

expect_table_snapshot(sess, label = NULL, variant = NULL)

Arguments

sess

A macrox_session object, or a plain data frame.

label

Character label of the table to snapshot. Ignored when sess is already a data frame.

variant

Optional variant string passed to testthat::expect_snapshot(), allowing multiple snapshots per test.

Value

The result of expect_snapshot(), invisibly.

Details

Must be called inside a testthat test (i.e., within test_that()).
